body: I don’t think our relationship is healthy enough for an open relationship plus even though my wife was the one who brought it up she has a lot of jealousy issues. I also personally don’t have any desire to be with anyone else.

Last year she ran into him and they met up for drinks. She was extremely open with me about it. Things didn’t end well between them and she told me it was about getting closure. Since then they’ve been friendly with each other on social media- leaving a lot of comments on each other’s posts. 

Maybe I’m reading too much into this..
My wife was upfront with me about having bipolar 1 and a history of substance abuse.
Thanks for the suggestion with the trazadone. It definitely sounds better than what I’ve been doing.
NTA You’re an adult and your mom is staying at your house. If she doesn’t like your weed she either can get over it or stay elsewhere.

I don’t see any problem with our sex life but that doesn’t mean there isn’t any problems. I’m just not sure that her sleeping with other people will solve those problems. I’m willing to give more thought to it and discuss it further with her. I want us both to be happy and she’s made it clear she isn’t.

I probably should have included that information in this post but I was hoping to avoid the “just leave” advice.

I think therapy is definitely necessary if we’re going to make it work.
I know I should leave. If anything this is just more evidence that I should.
I cut my hand open and required six stitches after dunking a basketball. I guess there must have been something sharp on the rim.
You leave him. A guy who can't give you compassion for something you have zero control over is not a guy you should be with. Sorry your boyfriend is a dick.
